verdict.rationale: LiveKit documents a first-party self-hosting deployment path, and a hands-on probe booted the OSS server locally with no account. Self-hosting lets a user keep the realtime backbone on infrastructure in a location they choose. Nothing in the evidence documents explicit region selection or data-residency controls for LiveKit Cloud, which is described only as 'global infrastructure'. missing for 10: documented region/residency selection in LiveKit Cloud, residency guarantees or compliance documentation, residency controls covering LiveKit Inference and stored data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: In order to have a secure LiveKit deployment, you will need a domain as well as a SSL certificate for that domain.
